info.text:
Americans saved just 4.1% of disposable income in August 2026, and only 63% of adults say they'd cover a $400 surprise with cash or its equivalent. We look at where the average household's $78,535 actually goes, why budgets fail, how to build one in four steps with sinking funds, and how 50/30/20, zero-based and pay-yourself-first budgets compare.

0:00 Intro
0:48 Why budgets fail
1:43 Where money goes
3:19 Build it in 4 steps
4:48 Pick a method
6:42 Make it stick
8:18 Recap

Sources:
- BEA, Personal Income and Outlays, August 2026 (Sept 30, 2026)
- Federal Reserve, Economic Well-Being of U.S. Households in 2025 (May 2026)
- BLS, Consumer Expenditures 2024 (Dec 19, 2025) and earlier releases
- Elizabeth Warren and Amelia Warren Tyagi, All Your Worth (2005)

News and education, not financial advice.
